source_to_record.source_anchor_editorial_summary: Term ruler containing thief significator is used to judge alleged social condition
Unfortunate planet in fortunate term — alleged rise from low social standing
Fortunate planet in unfortunate term — inverse standing change
If he carried all with him — heading
Seventh ruler angular — intended to carry all but could not
Seventh ruler succedent with eighth ruler strongly accompanying — carried all
Seventh and eighth rulers both cadent — neither took nor held goods
The distance of the thing from owner — heading
Degrees between thief significator and Moon, fixed — mile per degree
Same degrees common sign — tenths of mile per degree
Same degrees movable sign — rods per degree
Degrees between seventh ruler and hour lord — thousands of paces
Distance between ascendant and its lord — thing's distance from where lost
Significator's degrees into own sign — miles for cattle; fourth ruler quarter
How far the thing is from Querent — new heading
Whole signs between ascendant and its lord; fixed — four miles per sign
Whole signs between ascendant and its lord; common — 1.5 miles per sign
Whole signs between ascendant and its lord; movable — half-mile per sign; continues printed351

source_scope_note: Three distinct distance systems plus cattle method; do not harmonize units or assign verified real-world accuracy.
